property_summary: The reference function assertionResolvedCallback always reverts for non-optimistic-asserter callers, while the buggy version succeeds for any caller, breaking expected access control.
change_summary: Remove the entire body of assertionResolvedCallback so the function does nothing, changing its behavior from a no-op revert (due to onlyOptimisticAsserter) to a no-op that succeeds for any caller.
